title: RSI-Prime: Training Models to Train Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.23138v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enabling large language models (LLMs) to autonomously conduct training and improve target models is an important foundation for recursive self-improvement (RSI). As LLMs expand their role from being trained to conducting training, their model-training capability warrants dedicated study and systematic development. translated_abstract: 使大语言模型（LLM）能够自主开展训练并改进目标模型，是实现递归自我改进（RSI）的重要基础。随着LLM的角色从“被训练者”扩展为“训练者”，其模型训练能力值得专门研究和系统性发展。为此，我们构建了RSI-Prime——一个用于提升模型训练能力的数据集，包含覆盖七个任务类别的350条完整实验轨迹。为帮助LLM从训练实践中学会做出高质量的实验决策，我们进行了细粒度的决策识别与质量标注，并采用决策级损失掩码来排除对低质量行为的监督。在自主后训练基准PostTrainBench上使用GLM-5.3进行的实验表明，基于RSI-Prime的训练使整体性能相比原始GLM-5.3取得了31.95%的相对提升，突显了一条有前景的路径（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出RSI-Prime数据集（含覆盖七大任务类别的350条完整实验轨迹），通过细粒度决策质量标注与决策级损失掩码过滤低质量行为进行训练，使GLM-5.3在自主后训练基准PostTrainBench上整体性能相对提升31.95%，为递归自我改进奠定基础。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RSI-Prime, a dataset of 350 complete experimental trajectories across seven task categories, using fine-grained decision-level quality annotation and loss masking to filter out low-quality behaviors, which yields a 31.95% relative performance improvement for GLM-5.3 on the PostTrainBench autonomous post-training benchmark, laying a foundation for recursive self-improvement.
